metadata.title: Frontend Placement Practice Question Bank
metadata.purpose: Practice tasks for placement-style frontend implementation, partial implementation, and bug-fixing rounds.
metadata.provenance_note: Original practice questions modeled on publicly discussed frontend assessment patterns and standard web-development skills. They are not all verified verbatim questions from Accenture or Cognizant examinations. Reference material includes publicly available practice repositories and MDN documentation.

reference_sources.title: Accenture placement prep: HTML, CSS and JavaScript coding questions

schema_notes.starter_code: null means starter files can be supplied or generated separately.
schema_notes.test_cases: Empty arrays are placeholders for executable tests or manual evaluation rubrics.

questions.title: Build a semantic registration form
questions.prompt: Create a registration form with name, email, password, gender, skills, and submit controls.
acceptance_criteria: Use semantic form markup, associated labels, masked password, grouped radio buttons, and required fields.

questions.title: Fix labels that do not focus inputs
questions.prompt: Repair a form where clicking labels does not focus the intended inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Match label for attributes to unique input IDs and preserve accessible names.

questions.title: Create a student profile page
questions.prompt: Build a profile page with photo, name, degree, skills, and contact links.
acceptance_criteria: Use semantic sections, meaningful alt text, valid links, and a logical heading hierarchy.

questions.title: Implement a product comparison table
questions.prompt: Complete a table comparing three products by name, price, rating, and availability.
acceptance_criteria: Use caption, thead, tbody, and appropriate header cells.

questions.title: Create a job application form
questions.prompt: Build a form with name, email, phone, role dropdown, resume upload, and consent checkbox.
acceptance_criteria: Use suitable input types, required fields, file accept filters, and clear labels.

questions.title: Fix invalid nested HTML elements
questions.prompt: Repair markup that nests paragraphs inside paragraphs and puts list items outside a list.
acceptance_criteria: Use valid element nesting and preserve intended content.

questions.title: Add an accessible navigation menu
questions.prompt: Complete navigation links for Home, Services, Careers, and Contact.
acceptance_criteria: Use nav/list semantics and meaningful link destinations.

questions.title: Create a feedback form with rating
questions.prompt: Build a feedback form with name, 1–5 rating, comments, and submit button.
acceptance_criteria: Use fieldset/legend, labels, and required validation.

questions.title: Add video fallback content
questions.prompt: Complete an HTML video element for a demo clip.
acceptance_criteria: Include controls, source MIME type, and fallback text.

questions.title: Fix form submission refreshing the page
questions.prompt: A form should show a success message but the page reloads on submit.
acceptance_criteria: Handle submit, prevent default when appropriate, validate input, and show feedback.

questions.title: Create a responsive navigation bar
questions.prompt: Style a horizontal desktop navigation bar that stacks cleanly on narrow screens.
acceptance_criteria: Use Flexbox and media queries
prevent overflow.

questions.title: Center a login card
questions.prompt: Complete CSS to center a login card horizontally and vertically.
acceptance_criteria: Use a robust layout, constrained width, and mobile padding.

questions.title: Build a three-card responsive layout
questions.prompt: Create three service cards with title, description, and action button.
acceptance_criteria: Use Grid/Flexbox and switch to one column on small screens.

questions.title: Fix box model overflow
questions.prompt: A 100%-wide input with padding extends beyond its parent.
acceptance_criteria: Correct box sizing and use responsive widths.

questions.title: Create a two-column dashboard layout
questions.prompt: Build a sidebar and main content area that collapses on mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Use Grid/Flexbox, consistent gaps, and a mobile breakpoint.

questions.title: Style a button with hover and focus states
questions.prompt: Complete primary-button hover, active, and keyboard-focus styles.
acceptance_criteria: Maintain contrast and visible :focus-visible indication.

questions.title: Fix CSS selector specificity
questions.prompt: An intended class color is overridden by a more specific selector.
acceptance_criteria: Fix the cascade without unnecessary !important rules.

questions.title: Create a sticky header
questions.prompt: Keep a page header visible while scrolling.
acceptance_criteria: Use position: sticky and check ancestor overflow behavior.

questions.title: Build a pricing table
questions.prompt: Create three pricing cards with plan, price, features, and CTA.
acceptance_criteria: Use consistent spacing, responsive layout, and distinguish the recommended plan.

questions.title: Fix image stretching in cards
questions.prompt: Product images have different aspect ratios and appear distorted.
acceptance_criteria: Use object-fit and a consistent image container
retain useful alt text.

questions.title: Create a CSS-only tooltip
questions.prompt: Add a tooltip to an information icon without JavaScript.
acceptance_criteria: Support hover and keyboard focus
keep the explanation accessible.

questions.title: Implement a dark-mode toggle
questions.prompt: Add a button that switches between light and dark themes.
acceptance_criteria: Toggle a class/data attribute, update button state, and maintain contrast.

questions.title: Fix mobile horizontal scrolling
questions.prompt: A page scrolls horizontally on mobile due to an oversized section.
acceptance_criteria: Find the overflowing element and correct its responsive sizing.

questions.title: Create a loading skeleton
questions.prompt: Style placeholder blocks while profile data loads.
acceptance_criteria: Use subtle animation, respect reduced-motion preferences, and avoid layout shifts.

questions.title: Build a simple calculator
questions.prompt: Implement addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division from two inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Validate numbers and handle division by zero.

questions.title: Fix a counter that increments twice
questions.prompt: A counter click handler runs twice per click.
acceptance_criteria: Remove duplicate listener registration and test repeated interactions.

questions.title: Implement password visibility toggle
questions.prompt: Add a show/hide control beside a password input.
acceptance_criteria: Switch input type and update the button's accessible label.

questions.title: Validate an email and password form
questions.prompt: Validate required fields, email format, and password minimum length.
acceptance_criteria: Show field-level messages and prevent invalid submission.

questions.title: Fix a broken character counter
questions.prompt: A textarea character counter does not update while typing or pasting.
acceptance_criteria: Listen to input events and count the current value.

questions.title: Build a to-do list
questions.prompt: Let users add tasks, mark them complete, and delete them.
acceptance_criteria: Handle empty input, create DOM nodes safely, and support keyboard submission.

questions.title: Implement live search filtering
questions.prompt: Complete a search box that filters a predefined list as the user types.
acceptance_criteria: Use input events, case-insensitive matching, and a no-results state.

questions.title: Fix remove buttons deleting the wrong row
questions.prompt: In a dynamic list, Delete removes a different row than the selected one.
acceptance_criteria: Scope handlers correctly or use event delegation
avoid fragile indexes.

questions.title: Create an image carousel
questions.prompt: Implement next/previous controls for a small image carousel.
acceptance_criteria: Handle boundaries consistently and update alt text/current-slide indicator.

questions.title: Implement a modal dialog
questions.prompt: Open a modal and close it using a close button, Escape, or backdrop click.
acceptance_criteria: Manage visibility, focus, keyboard behavior, and dialog semantics.

questions.title: Fix a dropdown that closes before selection
questions.prompt: A custom dropdown disappears before its option click handler runs.
acceptance_criteria: Inspect event propagation and blur ordering
preserve keyboard access.

questions.title: Build a live word counter
questions.prompt: Complete a textarea word counter treating multiple spaces as one separator.
acceptance_criteria: Trim input, handle empty strings, and update on input.

questions.title: Sort a table by column
questions.prompt: Sort a table by name and numeric score when headers are clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Compare numbers numerically and indicate sort direction.

questions.title: Fix NaN in a total-price calculator
questions.prompt: A cart total becomes NaN when quantity or price fields are empty.
acceptance_criteria: Convert and validate values explicitly
define empty-value behavior.

questions.title: Build a shopping cart quantity updater
questions.prompt: Update cart item quantities and recalculate line and grand totals.
acceptance_criteria: Validate minimum quantity and format currency consistently.

questions.title: Implement a countdown timer
questions.prompt: Complete a countdown that updates every second and stops at zero.
acceptance_criteria: Clear the interval, prevent negative time, and avoid duplicate timers.

questions.title: Fix a fetch UI stuck on loading
questions.prompt: A page fetches data but remains on Loading when the request fails.
acceptance_criteria: Handle errors and reset loading state in finally
display useful feedback.

questions.title: Build a weather-card UI from supplied data
questions.prompt: Render city, temperature, condition, and icon from a supplied object.
acceptance_criteria: Handle missing fields and avoid injecting untrusted HTML.

questions.title: Implement tabs for a content panel
questions.prompt: Create three tabs that display the matching panel.
acceptance_criteria: Update active styles and aria-selected
support keyboard focus.

questions.title: Fix event listeners on dynamic items
questions.prompt: Buttons added after page load do not respond to existing listeners.
acceptance_criteria: Use event delegation or attach handlers during element creation.

questions.title: Create a responsive login page
questions.prompt: Recreate a login screen from a supplied visual brief and assets.
acceptance_criteria: Match spacing, typography, alignment, and mobile behavior.

questions.title: Implement field-level form errors
questions.prompt: Show a specific message beside each invalid field after submission.
acceptance_criteria: Associate messages with fields, set aria-invalid, and focus the first invalid control.

questions.title: Fix a mobile menu button
questions.prompt: A mobile menu button changes no visible state when clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Toggle menu visibility and update aria-expanded.

questions.title: Build a FAQ accordion
questions.prompt: Create expandable FAQ answers and choose whether multiple items can stay open.
acceptance_criteria: Use buttons, aria-expanded, controlled panels, and visible focus styles.

questions.title: Implement a debounced search box
questions.prompt: Delay filtering or API calls until typing pauses briefly.
acceptance_criteria: Clear prior timeout, use configurable delay, and avoid stale async results.

questions.title: Fix a theme preference not persisting
questions.prompt: Dark mode resets after refresh despite using localStorage.
acceptance_criteria: Load the saved preference on startup and persist changes safely.

questions.title: Build a semantic blog article page
questions.prompt: Create an article page with title, author, publication date, sections, and related links.
acceptance_criteria: Use article/header/footer semantics
preserve heading order and meaningful links.

questions.title: Create an accessible image gallery
questions.prompt: Build a gallery of six images with captions.
acceptance_criteria: Use figure/figcaption and descriptive alt text.

questions.title: Add metadata to a landing page
questions.prompt: Complete the head section for a responsive landing page.
acceptance_criteria: Add charset, viewport, descriptive title, and meta description.

questions.title: Fix duplicate element IDs
questions.prompt: A page has multiple elements sharing the same ID and scripts target the wrong one.
acceptance_criteria: Make IDs unique and update references appropriately.

questions.title: Build a multi-step checkout form structure
questions.prompt: Create contact, delivery, and payment sections with clear grouping.
acceptance_criteria: Use fieldsets/legends where useful, labels, and correct input types.

questions.title: Create an FAQ page with details elements
questions.prompt: Complete a FAQ using native expandable disclosure elements.
acceptance_criteria: Use details/summary and meaningful question text.

questions.title: Add accessible skip navigation
questions.prompt: Add a skip link that jumps directly to the main content.
acceptance_criteria: Ensure target exists and link is visible on keyboard focus.

questions.title: Fix buttons that accidentally submit forms
questions.prompt: Buttons used for toggling a panel submit the form unexpectedly.
acceptance_criteria: Set appropriate button types and retain the intended submit control.

questions.title: Create a downloadable resume section
questions.prompt: Add a resume download link and contact links to a portfolio page.
acceptance_criteria: Use descriptive link text and valid href values.

questions.title: Build a responsive image using picture
questions.prompt: Complete markup that serves different image sources at different widths.
acceptance_criteria: Use source media/type correctly and provide an img fallback.

questions.title: Create a CSS grid photo gallery
questions.prompt: Arrange images in a responsive grid with consistent gaps.
acceptance_criteria: Use grid-template-columns with responsive sizing and no overflow.

questions.title: Fix flex items not wrapping
questions.prompt: A row of tags extends beyond the card on narrow screens.
acceptance_criteria: Enable wrapping and manage gaps and min-width constraints.

questions.title: Create a hero section with CTA
questions.prompt: Build a landing hero with headline, description, CTA, and illustration.
acceptance_criteria: Use responsive spacing and readable line lengths.

questions.title: Build a responsive footer
questions.prompt: Create a footer with company details, navigation, and social links.
acceptance_criteria: Use semantic footer markup and stack columns on mobile.

questions.title: Fix z-index dropdown overlap
questions.prompt: A dropdown appears behind a neighboring card.
acceptance_criteria: Inspect stacking contexts and position/z-index relationships.

questions.title: Create a CSS progress bar
questions.prompt: Style a progress indicator showing 65% completion.
acceptance_criteria: Expose progress semantics and keep visual width synchronized with value.

questions.title: Create a notification toast style
questions.prompt: Style success and error toast variants.
acceptance_criteria: Ensure sufficient contrast and avoid relying on color alone.

questions.title: Build a profile avatar with status badge
questions.prompt: Place an online/offline status indicator on an avatar.
acceptance_criteria: Use a positioned wrapper and provide text or accessible status context.

questions.title: Fix text overflowing a card
questions.prompt: Long usernames or URLs break a card layout.
acceptance_criteria: Use appropriate wrapping and min-width rules without clipping essential content.

questions.title: Create a responsive sidebar
questions.prompt: Build a sidebar that becomes a top navigation on small screens.
acceptance_criteria: Use grid/flex layout and clear active navigation state.

questions.title: Create a CSS-only skeleton shimmer alternative
questions.prompt: Add a loading placeholder with a restrained shimmer effect.
acceptance_criteria: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and maintain stable layout dimensions.

questions.title: Build a two-column contact section
questions.prompt: Show contact details beside a contact form on desktop and stack on mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Use responsive Grid and consistent form spacing.

questions.title: Fix CSS variables not applying
questions.prompt: Theme colors are undefined because custom properties are scoped incorrectly.
acceptance_criteria: Define variables in a suitable scope and use valid var() syntax.

questions.title: Create a badge system
questions.prompt: Style badges for pending, approved, and rejected statuses.
acceptance_criteria: Provide consistent sizing and non-color status labels.

questions.title: Build a responsive testimonial card
questions.prompt: Create a testimonial with quote, person, role, and avatar.
acceptance_criteria: Use semantic quotation markup where appropriate and responsive layout.

questions.title: Implement a live digital clock
questions.prompt: Display the current local time and update it every second.
acceptance_criteria: Format time consistently and clear intervals if the view is removed.

questions.title: Fix a clock that drifts or duplicates intervals
questions.prompt: Repeatedly starting a clock creates multiple intervals.
acceptance_criteria: Store and clear the interval handle before starting another.

questions.title: Build a random quote generator
questions.prompt: Show a random quote from a supplied array when a button is clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Handle empty data and avoid repeating the same quote when practical.

questions.title: Implement a character limit with remaining count
questions.prompt: Limit a message to 200 characters and display remaining characters.
acceptance_criteria: Keep count accurate for typing, paste, and deletion.

questions.title: Fix array filtering that mutates source data
questions.prompt: Filtering a list unexpectedly changes the original dataset.
acceptance_criteria: Use non-mutating array methods and verify repeated filters.

questions.title: Implement a quiz with score summary
questions.prompt: Render multiple-choice questions and show score at completion.
acceptance_criteria: Track answers, prevent duplicate scoring, and handle unanswered questions.

questions.title: Build a persistent notes app
questions.prompt: Create, edit, delete, and persist notes across refreshes.
acceptance_criteria: Serialize data safely to localStorage and handle invalid stored JSON.

questions.title: Fix localStorage JSON parsing crash
questions.prompt: An old or malformed saved value crashes the page during startup.
acceptance_criteria: Wrap parsing defensively and provide a safe fallback.

questions.title: Implement a shopping product filter
questions.prompt: Filter product objects by category and maximum price.
acceptance_criteria: Combine filters correctly and show an empty result message.

questions.title: Build a pagination component
questions.prompt: Display a large list in pages with next, previous, and page numbers.
acceptance_criteria: Clamp page boundaries and render the correct slice.

questions.title: Fix sort order changing the original array
questions.prompt: Calling sort changes the shared source array and breaks another view.
acceptance_criteria: Sort a copy or use a non-mutating approach.

questions.title: Implement a tab switcher from data attributes
questions.prompt: Activate the panel associated with the clicked tab.
acceptance_criteria: Map data attributes reliably and synchronize active/hidden states.

questions.title: Build a searchable employee table
questions.prompt: Render employees and filter by name or department.
acceptance_criteria: Use case-insensitive matching and update results without duplicating rows.

questions.title: Fix a stale value in a click handler
questions.prompt: A handler keeps using an earlier variable value after the UI changes.
acceptance_criteria: Read current state at the right time and avoid stale captured values.

questions.title: Implement a debounce utility
questions.prompt: Write a reusable debounce function and demonstrate it with search input.
acceptance_criteria: Cancel previous timeout and preserve arguments and calling context.

questions.title: Build a throttle utility
questions.prompt: Limit how often a resize or scroll callback runs.
acceptance_criteria: Ensure predictable leading/trailing behavior and test rapid events.

questions.title: Fix a promise chain swallowing errors
questions.prompt: An asynchronous operation fails but no error message is shown.
acceptance_criteria: Propagate or catch rejections and render a recoverable error state.

questions.title: Implement async fetch with retry button
questions.prompt: Fetch a list from a supplied endpoint and provide retry after failure.
acceptance_criteria: Handle HTTP errors, loading state, and repeated requests.

questions.title: Build a weather search UI using mock data
questions.prompt: Search cities in a supplied weather dataset and render results.
acceptance_criteria: Handle missing cities, empty input, and safe DOM rendering.

questions.title: Fix duplicate list entries after refresh
questions.prompt: Saved items are appended to existing markup and appear twice.
acceptance_criteria: Clear or reconcile the rendered list before drawing saved items.

questions.title: Implement a copy-to-clipboard button
questions.prompt: Copy a supplied code snippet and show success/failure feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Use Clipboard API where available and handle rejected promises.

questions.title: Build a password strength indicator
questions.prompt: Estimate password strength from length and character variety.
acceptance_criteria: Explain criteria, update live, and avoid claiming server-side security.

questions.title: Fix a modal closing when clicking inside it
questions.prompt: Clicking modal content triggers the backdrop close handler.
acceptance_criteria: Distinguish backdrop clicks from dialog content events.

questions.title: Implement a sortable list with up/down controls
questions.prompt: Allow users to reorder list items using accessible buttons.
acceptance_criteria: Update data and DOM consistently and disable moves at boundaries.

questions.title: Build a progress tracker for a multi-step form
questions.prompt: Show current step and completion progress through three form steps.
acceptance_criteria: Validate before advancing and allow navigating back.

questions.title: Fix a form accepting whitespace-only values
questions.prompt: A required name field passes validation when it contains spaces.
acceptance_criteria: Trim values before checking and provide a clear message.

questions.title: Implement dependent country and city dropdowns
questions.prompt: Populate city options based on selected country using supplied data.
acceptance_criteria: Reset invalid city selections and handle empty option lists.

questions.title: Build a cart discount calculator
questions.prompt: Apply a percentage coupon to subtotal and calculate final total.
acceptance_criteria: Validate coupon rules and avoid floating-point display artifacts.

questions.title: Fix floating-point currency display
questions.prompt: Adding decimal prices shows results such as 19.999999.
acceptance_criteria: Use integer minor units or currency formatting for calculations and display.

questions.title: Implement a stopwatch
questions.prompt: Create start, pause, reset, and elapsed-time display controls.
acceptance_criteria: Prevent duplicate timers and preserve elapsed time across pause/resume.

questions.title: Build a keyboard-accessible dropdown menu
questions.prompt: Create a menu that opens with a button and supports Escape and keyboard navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Manage focus, expanded state, and click-outside behavior.

questions.title: Fix event bubbling in nested cards
questions.prompt: Clicking a nested action also triggers the parent card action.
acceptance_criteria: Use event delegation carefully and stop propagation only where appropriate.

questions.title: Implement a character-by-character typing effect
questions.prompt: Reveal a heading progressively and provide a reduced-motion fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Clear timers when complete and avoid restarting unnecessarily.

questions.title: Build a reusable DOM element renderer
questions.prompt: Write a function that renders a list of objects into cards.
acceptance_criteria: Separate rendering logic and use textContent for untrusted strings.

questions.title: Fix XSS risk from innerHTML
questions.prompt: User-provided comments are inserted directly using innerHTML.
acceptance_criteria: Render untrusted text safely and explain when sanitization is required.

questions.title: Implement a click-outside handler
questions.prompt: Close a popover when the user clicks outside its container.
acceptance_criteria: Ignore clicks inside and remove listeners when no longer needed.

questions.title: Build a responsive product detail page
questions.prompt: Show product image, title, price, description, and add-to-cart button.
acceptance_criteria: Use responsive columns, accessible controls, and clear hierarchy.

questions.title: Implement a star rating input
questions.prompt: Let users select a rating from one to five stars.
acceptance_criteria: Support keyboard interaction and expose the selected value accessibly.

questions.title: Fix a checkbox select-all feature
questions.prompt: Select-all does not reflect individual checkbox changes correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Synchronize master and child checkboxes and handle an indeterminate state.

questions.title: Build a select-all bulk action toolbar
questions.prompt: Select rows and enable a bulk action only when at least one row is selected.
acceptance_criteria: Track selected items accurately and update accessible status.

questions.title: Implement a file upload preview
questions.prompt: Preview selected image files before submission.
acceptance_criteria: Validate file type/size and release object URLs when replaced.

questions.title: Fix a file input not resetting
questions.prompt: Selecting the same file twice does not trigger the expected change flow.
acceptance_criteria: Reset the input value at the correct point and preserve selected-file handling.

questions.title: Build a drag-and-drop-free task reorder interface
questions.prompt: Move tasks up and down with buttons and persist their order.
acceptance_criteria: Keep accessible controls and save updated order.

questions.title: Implement a countdown to a supplied deadline
questions.prompt: Display days, hours, minutes, and seconds until a target date.
acceptance_criteria: Handle invalid/past dates and stop updates at zero.

questions.title: Fix timezone assumptions in date display
questions.prompt: A date-only string displays on the previous day in some time zones.
acceptance_criteria: Parse date-only values deliberately and document local/UTC behavior.

questions.title: Build a calendar month grid
questions.prompt: Render a month with weekday headings and correctly placed date cells.
acceptance_criteria: Handle month lengths, leap years, and first weekday.

questions.title: Implement a simple expense tracker
questions.prompt: Add expenses with description, category, and amount; show total by category.
acceptance_criteria: Validate amounts and update totals after deletion.

questions.title: Fix delete action after filtering
questions.prompt: Deleting a filtered item removes a different record because visible indexes are used.
acceptance_criteria: Use stable IDs rather than display indexes.

questions.title: Build a keyboard shortcut help overlay
questions.prompt: Open a shortcut help panel with ? and close with Escape.
acceptance_criteria: Avoid intercepting typing in inputs and clean up event listeners.

questions.title: Implement a print-friendly invoice
questions.prompt: Style an invoice screen and add print-specific layout rules.
acceptance_criteria: Use @media print and hide interactive controls when printing.

questions.title: Fix CSS animation ignoring reduced-motion setting
questions.prompt: A decorative animation runs even when reduced motion is preferred.
acceptance_criteria: Add prefers-reduced-motion handling and preserve content clarity.

questions.title: Build a responsive dashboard KPI row
questions.prompt: Display four KPI cards that wrap or stack on smaller screens.
acceptance_criteria: Use responsive Grid, consistent card dimensions, and readable labels.

questions.title: Implement a notification center
questions.prompt: List notifications, mark one read, and clear all read items.
acceptance_criteria: Update state consistently and expose unread status as text.

questions.title: Fix a stale search response overwriting newer results
questions.prompt: A slow earlier search response replaces results from a newer query.
acceptance_criteria: Cancel requests or ignore stale responses using request IDs/AbortController.

questions.title: Implement an abortable search request
questions.prompt: Cancel the previous fetch when a new search query starts.
acceptance_criteria: Use AbortController and handle abort separately from genuine failures.

questions.title: Build a form autosave draft
questions.prompt: Save form progress locally and restore it when the page is reopened.
acceptance_criteria: Avoid saving sensitive fields unnecessarily and handle malformed storage.

questions.title: Fix autosave overwriting newer form state
questions.prompt: A delayed save writes an older snapshot over a newer draft.
acceptance_criteria: Debounce carefully and serialize the current state at save time.

questions.title: Implement a custom confirmation dialog
questions.prompt: Ask for confirmation before deleting an item and handle cancel/confirm.
acceptance_criteria: Use accessible dialog behavior and only delete after confirmation.

questions.title: Build a before-and-after image comparison layout
questions.prompt: Display two images with aligned dimensions and labels.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve aspect ratio and provide meaningful text alternatives.

questions.title: Fix a sticky footer overlapping page content
questions.prompt: A fixed footer hides the last items in a long page.
acceptance_criteria: Prefer a flex-column page layout or reserve appropriate content space.

questions.title: Implement a responsive step indicator
questions.prompt: Show completed, current, and upcoming steps in a workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Use text/state cues in addition to color and adapt labels on mobile.

questions.title: Build a filterable FAQ list
questions.prompt: Search FAQ questions and expand matching answers.
acceptance_criteria: Use case-insensitive filtering and announce no-results state.

questions.title: Fix a clear-search button not updating results
questions.prompt: Clearing the search field leaves the previous filtered results visible.
acceptance_criteria: Reset state and trigger the same render/filter path as input changes.

questions.title: Implement a basic client-side router
questions.prompt: Switch between Home, About, and Help views using the URL hash.
acceptance_criteria: Handle initial route, hash changes, and unknown routes.

questions.title: Build a breadcrumb trail
questions.prompt: Show Home, category, and current page navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Use nav with an accessible label and mark the current page.

questions.title: Fix a navigation link targeting the wrong section
questions.prompt: A table-of-contents link points to a nonexistent fragment ID.
acceptance_criteria: Match href fragments to unique target IDs.

questions.title: Implement an accessible carousel pause control
questions.prompt: Create an auto-advancing carousel with pause/resume and manual controls.
acceptance_criteria: Pause on user request, support reduced motion, and expose slide context.

questions.title: Build a simple memory matching game
questions.prompt: Create a grid of paired cards and track turns and matched pairs.
acceptance_criteria: Prevent rapid repeated flips and detect game completion.

questions.title: Fix game state allowing more than two cards open
questions.prompt: Players can reveal several cards before the mismatch timeout completes.
acceptance_criteria: Guard state transitions and clear pending timeout safely.

questions.title: Implement a theme selector with three themes
questions.prompt: Switch between light, dark, and high-contrast themes.
acceptance_criteria: Use CSS custom properties and persist non-sensitive preference.

questions.title: Build a responsive comparison slider substitute
questions.prompt: Use a range input to adjust the visible portion of two aligned images.
acceptance_criteria: Keep the range keyboard-accessible and update the visual clip accurately.

questions.title: Fix memory leaks from event listeners
questions.prompt: A component adds listeners each time it opens and never removes them.
acceptance_criteria: Use cleanup functions or AbortController-bound listeners.

questions.title: Implement a reusable form validator
questions.prompt: Create a validation function that checks required, email, and minimum-length rules.
acceptance_criteria: Return structured errors and keep validation logic separate from UI updates.

questions.title: Build a results summary panel
questions.prompt: Summarize selected answers, correct count, and percentage after a quiz.
acceptance_criteria: Handle zero questions and calculate percentage safely.

questions.title: Fix percentage calculation when total is zero
questions.prompt: A score summary displays NaN when there are no questions.
acceptance_criteria: Define zero-total behavior and prevent invalid division.
